summary: Direct Alabama mobile golf-sim competitors are thin and mostly quote-only (Triangle Lawn Games, Clubhouse Golf) except one published price: Alabama Indoor Golf League's Birmingham DIY drop-off special at $299 for 24 hours (not a staffed party rate). WeGo Golf, the national operator serving Mobile/Huntsville/Montgomery, anchors the premium end with turnkey packages "starting at $2,500." The Southeast reference market (Atlanta) runs $150-250/hr for inflatable-tier rigs, $250-450/hr for mid-tier regional pop-ups, and $350-500/hr (2-hr min) for premium operators like Dryvebox, whose day rates run $2,500-5,000. Comparable Alabama premium event rentals (photo booths $895-1,095 per 3-hr package, casino tables $349-849 per table for up to 3 hrs) cluster in the same $300-450/hr-equivalent band as the mid-to-premium golf-sim tier, which is the right positioning zone for a new Alabama entrant: above the AIGL bargain-DIY price and fixed-bay venues ($35-60/hr), below Atlanta big-market premium and WeGo's turnkey floor. Recommended launch anchor: "Starting at $499" (2-hr party minimum, ~$250/hr effective), building to an $849 four-hour package and a $1,599 full-day corporate package, all still well under both Dryvebox Atlanta and WeGo Golf's Alabama-serving price points.

findings.price_structure: Starting at $499 (2-hour minimum, staffed single-bay setup) -- roughly $250/hr effective
findings.notes: Positioned above AIGL's $299 DIY/24-hr bargain special and above fixed-bay venues ($35-60/hr) which have no delivery or staffing, but below Southeast mid-tier ($250-450/hr) and well below Dryvebox Atlanta ($350-500/hr) and WeGo Golf's $2,500 turnkey floor. Matches the $250-365/hr-equivalent AL buyers already pay for photo booths and single casino tables, so it reads as a fair premium price, not a discount-bin one, while still undercutting every non-AIGL operator actually serving Alabama.

findings.price_structure: Package 1 "Party" -- 2 hrs, single bay, attendant: $499 flat (~$250/hr). Package 2 "Event" -- 4 hrs, single bay, attendant, up to ~30 guests: $849 flat (~$212/hr, volume discount). Package 3 "Corporate/Full-Day" -- 8 hrs, single bay (2nd bay optional add-on), attendant, leaderboard/branding options: $1,599 flat (~$200/hr, volume discount)
findings.notes: Full-day $1,599 sits comfortably under Dryvebox Atlanta's $2,500-5,000/day and under WeGo Golf's $2,500 turnkey starting point, giving a clear 'Alabama value' story against both in-state and reference-market comps. Per-hour discount ladder (250 -> 212 -> 200) mirrors how Dryvebox and Casino Knight both reward longer/multi-unit bookings. All three tiers still price meaningfully above AIGL's $299 DIY special to avoid a race-to-the-bottom self-comparison against the one in-state published price.
